/*
 * TOF Imaging Beamline
 * McStas 3.x instrument
 * 
 * Specification:
 * - Source_simple with focusing to aperture
 * - Circular aperture (radius = 0.5*ap_D)
 * - Scraper aperture (0.3 x 0.3 m)
 * - FOV monitor at 20 m (128x128, 0.28x0.28 m)
 * - Detector at 25 m (256x256, 0.2x0.2 m)
 * - Wavelength monitor at 25.01 m (200 bins)
 * 
 * Parameters:
 * - lam: central wavelength (Å)
 * - dlam: wavelength spread (Å)
 * - ap_D: aperture diameter parameter (m)
 */

DEFINE INSTRUMENT tof_imaging(
    lam = 3.5,
    dlam = 1.3,
    ap_D = 0.016
)

TRACE

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.1,
    dist = 1.0,
    focus_xw = ap_D,
    focus_yh = ap_D,
    lambda0 = lam,
    dlambda = dlam,
    flux = 1e13
)
AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT aperture = Slit(
    radius = 0.5 * ap_D
)
AT [0, 0, 1.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT scraper = Slit(
    xwidth = 0.3,
    yheight = 0.3
)
AT [0, 0, 10.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT fov_mon = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128,
    ny = 128,
    filename = "fov.dat",
    xwidth = 0.28,
    yheight = 0.28,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 20.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 256,
    ny = 256,
    filename = "det.dat",
    xwidth = 0.2,
    yheight = 0.2,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 25.0] RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det_lam = L_monitor(
    nL = 200,
    filename = "det_lam.dat",
    xwidth = 0.2,
    yheight = 0.2,
    Lmin = lam - 2*dlam,
    Lmax = lam + 2*dlam,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 25.01] RELATIVE src

END INSTRUMENT
```
